# Dataset class with augmentation
class DenoisingDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, noisy_dir, clean_dir, files, img_size=384, augment=False):
        self.noisy_dir = noisy_dir
        self.clean_dir = clean_dir
        self.files = files
        self.img_size = img_size
        self.augment = augment

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.files)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        filename = self.files[idx]

        # Load noisy image
        noisy_path = os.path.join(self.noisy_dir, filename)
        noisy_img = Image.open(noisy_path).convert("L")
        noisy_img = noisy_img.resize((self.img_size, self.img_size), Image.LANCZOS)
        noisy_array = np.array(noisy_img) / 255.0

        # Load clean image
        clean_path = os.path.join(self.clean_dir, filename)
        clean_img = Image.open(clean_path).convert("L")
        clean_img = clean_img.resize((self.img_size, self.img_size), Image.LANCZOS)
        clean_array = np.array(clean_img) / 255.0

        # Apply augmentation if enabled
        if self.augment:
            # Random horizontal flip
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy_array = np.fliplr(noisy_array)
                clean_array = np.fliplr(clean_array)

            # Random vertical flip
            if random.random() > 0.5:
                noisy_array = np.flipud(noisy_array)
                clean_array = np.flipud(clean_array)

            # Random rotation (up to 5 degrees)
            angle = random.uniform(-5, 5)
            noisy_img_rot = Image.fromarray((noisy_array * 255).astype(np.uint8))
            clean_img_rot = Image.fromarray((clean_array * 255).astype(np.uint8))
            noisy_img_rot = noisy_img_rot.rotate(angle, expand=False)
            clean_img_rot = clean_img_rot.rotate(angle, expand=False)
            noisy_array = np.array(noisy_img_rot) / 255.0
            clean_array = np.array(clean_img_rot) / 255.0

        # Convert to tensors
        noisy_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(noisy_array).unsqueeze(0)
        clean_tensor = torch.FloatTensor(clean_array).unsqueeze(0)

        return noisy_tensor, clean_tensor


# Attention Gate module
class AttentionGate(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, F_g, F_l, F_int):
        super().__init__()
        self.W_g = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_g, F_int, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0, bias=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int),
        )
        self.W_x = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_l, F_int, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0, bias=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(F_int),
        )
        self.psi = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(F_int, 1, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0, bias=True),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )
        self.relu = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)

    def forward(self, g, x):
        g1 = self.W_g(g)
        x1 = self.W_x(x)
        psi = self.relu(g1 + x1)
        psi = self.psi(psi)
        return x * psi


# U-Net architecture with attention gates and residual connections
class UNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels=1, out_channels=1):
        super().__init__()

        # Encoder
        self.enc1 = self.conv_block(in_channels, 64)
        self.enc2 = self.conv_block(64, 128)
        self.enc3 = self.conv_block(128, 256)
        self.enc4 = self.conv_block(256, 512)

        # Bottleneck
        self.bottleneck = self.conv_block(512, 1024)

        # Decoder with attention gates and residual connections
        self.up4 = self.up_conv(1024, 512)
        self.att4 = AttentionGate(F_g=512, F_l=512, F_int=256)
        self.dec4 = self.conv_block(1024, 512)
        self.up3 = self.up_conv(512, 256)
        self.att3 = AttentionGate(F_g=256, F_l=256, F_int=128)
        self.dec3 = self.conv_block(512, 256)
        self.up2 = self.up_conv(256, 128)
        self.att2 = AttentionGate(F_g=128, F_l=128, F_int=64)
        self.dec2 = self.conv_block(256, 128)
        self.up1 = self.up_conv(128, 64)
        self.att1 = AttentionGate(F_g=64, F_l=64, F_int=32)
        self.dec1 = self.conv_block(128, 64)

        # Output
        self.out = nn.Conv2d(64, out_channels, kernel_size=1)
        self.sigmoid = nn.Sigmoid()

        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(2)

    def conv_block(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(in_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(out_ch, out_ch, 3, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def up_conv(self, in_ch, out_ch):
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.ConvTranspose2d(in_ch, out_ch, 2, stride=2),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(out_ch),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        # Encoder
        e1 = self.enc1(x)
        e2 = self.enc2(self.pool(e1))
        e3 = self.enc3(self.pool(e2))
        e4 = self.enc4(self.pool(e3))

        # Bottleneck
        b = self.bottleneck(self.pool(e4))

        # Decoder with attention gates and residual connections
        up4 = self.up4(b)
        att4 = self.att4(up4, e4)
        cat4 = torch.cat([up4, att4], dim=1)
        d4 = self.dec4(cat4)
        d4 = d4 + att4

        up3 = self.up3(d4)
        att3 = self.att3(up3, e3)
        cat3 = torch.cat([up3, att3], dim=1)
        d3 = self.dec3(cat3)
        d3 = d3 + att3

        up2 = self.up2(d3)
        att2 = self.att2(up2, e2)
        cat2 = torch.cat([up2, att2], dim=1)
        d2 = self.dec2(cat2)
        d2 = d2 + att2

        up1 = self.up1(d2)
        att1 = self.att1(up1, e1)
        cat1 = torch.cat([up1, att1], dim=1)
        d1 = self.dec1(cat1)
        d1 = d1 + att1

        return self.sigmoid(self.out(d1))


def train_model(seed, train_files_split, val_files_split, train_files, num_epochs=50, img_size=384):
    """Train a single model with given seed"""
    # Set random seeds
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    
    # Create datasets and dataloaders
    train_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
        train_dir, train_cleaned_dir, train_files_split, img_size=img_size, augment=True
    )
    val_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
        train_dir, train_cleaned_dir, val_files_split, img_size=img_size, augment=False
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=2, shuffle=True, num_workers=0)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=2, shuffle=False, num_workers=0)

    # Initialize model
    model = UNet().to(device)
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
        optimizer, mode="min", patience=3, factor=0.5
    )

    # Training loop
    best_val_rmse = float("inf")
    best_model_state = None

    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        train_loss = 0
        for noisy, clean in train_loader:
            noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            output = model(noisy)
            loss = criterion(output, clean)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            train_loss += loss.item()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        val_loss = 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for noisy, clean in val_loader:
                noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
                output = model(noisy)
                loss = criterion(output, clean)
                val_loss += loss.item()

        train_loss /= len(train_loader)
        val_loss /= len(val_loader)
        val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss)
        scheduler.step(val_rmse)

        if val_rmse < best_val_rmse:
            best_val_rmse = val_rmse
            best_model_state = {k: v.cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}

        if (epoch + 1) % 10 == 0:
            print(f"Seed {seed} - Epoch {epoch+1}/{num_epochs} - Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    print(f"Seed {seed} - Best validation RMSE: {best_val_rmse:.4f}")

    # Load best model
    if best_model_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)

    # Retrain on full training data
    full_dataset = DenoisingDataset(
        train_dir, train_cleaned_dir, train_files, img_size=img_size, augment=True
    )
    full_loader = DataLoader(full_dataset, batch_size=2, shuffle=True, num_workers=0)

    model = UNet().to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    scheduler_full = optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(
        optimizer, T_max=num_epochs, eta_min=1e-6
    )

    for epoch in range(num_epochs):
        model.train()
        for noisy, clean in full_loader:
            noisy, clean = noisy.to(device), clean.to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            output = model(noisy)
            loss = criterion(output, clean)
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler_full.step()

    return model, best_val_rmse
